claim:
For every real \(\lambda\ge\sqrt2\), let \(R_\lambda^2=(\mathbb R^2,N_\lambda)\) with
\[
N_\lambda(u,v)=\max\left\{\lambda|u|,\sqrt{u^2+v^2}\right\}.
\]
For every \(p\in[2,\infty]\), the generalized Baronti constant satisfies
\[
A_{2,p}(R_\lambda^2)=1+\sqrt{1-\lambda^{-2}}.
\]
More precisely, if
\[
G_\lambda(\tau)=
\sup_{N_\lambda(x)=N_\lambda(y)=1}
\frac{N_\lambda(x+\tau y)+N_\lambda(x-\tau y)}2,
\qquad 0\le\tau\le1,
\]
then
\[
G_\lambda(\tau)=
\frac{1+\tau+\sqrt{1+2(1-2\lambda^{-2})\tau+\tau^2}}2.
\]
For every finite \(p\ge2\), the normalized Baronti profile
\[
\frac{2^{1/p}G_\lambda(\tau)}{(1+\tau^p)^{1/p}}
\]
is nondecreasing on \([0,1]\), so the maximum occurs at \(\tau=1\); for \(p=\infty\) the same conclusion follows directly from the displayed formula.
integrity: The proof optimizes all active-branch combinations over the complete unit ball through an exact support-function calculation. The p-profile monotonicity is proved symbolically. No numerical sampling or inaccessible source is used for correctness.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to the real two-dimensional Banaś--Frączek plane with lambda at least sqrt(2) and to generalized Baronti parameters p at least 2. No formula is asserted below the lambda threshold or for the generalized ell_r-based family.
title: A supra-Hilbert \(A_{2,p}\) plateau on Banaś--Frączek planes
